# Closerice 食評筆記 — AI agent instructions

Site: https://closerice.benny-cheung.chatgpt.site/
Human guide: https://closerice.benny-cheung.chatgpt.site/ai
Machine-readable API: https://closerice.benny-cheung.chatgpt.site/openapi.json

This is one shared collection. Anyone with the site URL can read, add, edit, or delete its records. No ChatGPT sign-in, API key, or separate MCP connection is required. Use these instructions only when the user asks you to work with Closerice.

To add a review from a screenshot:
1. Read the screenshot yourself. Extract only visible restaurant, food, order number, total paid, delivery service, complete dining date, and branch or address. Do not invent missing details. If a date lacks a year, ask the user. If the branch or address does not clearly show 旺角 or 尖沙咀, ask the user which district applies.
2. Ask the user for their own comment and 1–5 score if they have not supplied them. Do not infer taste or satisfaction from a receipt.
3. When the needed details are known, POST one application/json request to /api/agent/reviews. This creates the record directly; do not open an on-site draft or ask for a second save step.
4. Never upload or store the order screenshot. Use it only to extract text. Only a person intentionally choosing a food photo in the site's form should attach an image to a review.
5. A successful response is HTTP 201 with the saved id. Tell the user only after that response. If it fails, report the error and keep the unsaved details available for a retry.

Required fields: diningDate (YYYY-MM-DD), restaurant, food, channel (keeta, foodpanda, takeaway, or dine_in), district (mong_kok for 旺角 or tsim_sha_tsui for 尖沙咀).
Optional API fields: comment, score (integer 1–5), status (none, favorite, or blacklist), orderNumber, amountCents (integer Hong Kong cents). For AI-assisted reviews, collect the user's comment and score before saving unless they explicitly want to leave either blank.
Use channel=keeta for Keeta receipts, channel=foodpanda for foodpanda, channel=takeaway for self-pickup, and channel=dine_in for restaurant dining. Ask if unclear.

Example JSON:
{"diningDate":"2026-10-04","restaurant":"示例茶餐廳","food":"叉燒飯","comment":"份量足夠","score":4,"channel":"takeaway","district":"mong_kok","status":"none","orderNumber":"A123","amountCents":5800}

Read existing records with GET /api/reviews. Never modify or delete a record unless the user explicitly asks. API details and response schemas are in /openapi.json.
